name: Vigilante Noble Soul
body:
The call to heroism is in some people’s destiny, forcing them to act when others flee. Noble souls are more aware of this innate fate than any others, donning their identity to serve as a beacon of truth and nobility. Some noble souls stand firm against the crashing tides of evil in combat, while others provide aid to the wounded, but both have made it their life’s duty to defend this world against evil in all of its forms.

Noble Vigilante (Ex)

A noble soul’s vigilante alignment must be good, and their vigilante identity and their social identity must be within one step of each other on the alignment axis. In addition, if the noble soul’s social identity is not good, they can’t use their righteous vision, heroic specialization, or spellcasting class features.

Heroic Specialization (Su)

At 1st level, a noble soul must choose to be either a crusader or a healer.

A crusader gains the smite evil class feature of a paladin, treating their noble soul level as their paladin level for the purpose of how much damage they deal with this ability. At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, they can smite evil 1 additional time per day.

A healer gains the lay on hands class feature of a paladin, treating their vigilante level as their paladin level to determine how much they heal with this ability. A healer can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 their vigilante level plus their Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

This replaces vigilante specialization.

Noble Aura (Su)

At 1st level, a noble soul gains the aura of good class feature of a paladin while in their vigilante identity.

Righteous Vision (Su)

At 1st level, a noble soul gains the detect evil class feature of a paladin. This ability replaces the 1st level social talent.

Heroic Talents (Su)

A noble soul can select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents.

Avenging Smite (Su)

While a noble soul is smithing a foe, they treat their BAB as equal to their character level for the purpose of attacks being made against the target of their smite. Only a crusader noble soul can select this talent.

Divine Mount (Su)

A noble soul gains the divine bond class feature, although they can only select to gain a mount with this talent. A noble soul must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Focused Smite (Su)

A noble soul treats all evil foes as though they were outsiders with the evil subtype when determining how much damage their smile deals. Only a crusader noble soul can select this talent, and they must be 10th level or higher to select this talent.

Limited Divine Grace (Su)

A noble soul gains a bonus equal to their Charisma modifier (if any) on their saving throws; this bonus cannot exceed the noble soul’s character level.

Heroic Courage (Su)

A noble soul gains the aura of courage class feature of a paladin.

Life Link (Su)

A noble soul gains the life link revelation of a life mystery oracle.

Mercy (Su)

A noble soul gains a mercy as a paladin of their level. Only a healer noble soul can select this talent, and they must be 4th level or higher to select this talent, although they can select it multiple times, each time gaining a different mercy.

Protective Grace (Su)

If a noble soul is wearing light armor or no armor, they gain a bonus equal to their Charisma modifier (if any) to their armor class; this bonus cannot exceed the noble soul’s character level. Holding a shield does not affect this talent.

Unbound Smite (Su)

A noble soul treats all nongood creatures as evil for the purpose of their smite evil. Only a crusader noble soul can select this talent, and they must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

This ability alters vigilante talents.

Spellcasting At 4th level, a noble soul can cast divine spells as a paladin and uses the paladin’s spell list. A noble soul who is chaotic good replaces protection from chaos with protection from law, magic circle against chaos with magic circle against law, and dispel chaos with dispel law. A neutral good noble soul can choose to replace these spells once they gain this class feature. Once the choice to replace these spells has been made, it cannot be changed. This ability replaces the 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th level vigilante talents.

Ultimate Nobility (Su)

At 20th level, a crusader noble soul gains the true justice ability, while a healer noble soul gains the true compassion ability:

True Compassion (Su)

The noble soul treats their lay on hands as the heal and breath of life spells for which conditions it can remove and how it interacts with dead creatures.

True Justice (Su)

The noble soul auto confirms all critical threats made while using their smite evil.

This ability replaces vengeance strike.
